title: Quote: What I'm best at doing is finding a group of talented people...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Jobs Talks About His Rise and Fall
content: What I'm best at doing is finding a group of talented people and making things with them. I respect the direction that Apple is going in. But for me personally, you know, I want to make things. And if there's no place for me to make things there, then I'll do what I did twice before
full_transcript: What I'm best at doing is finding a group of talented people and making things with them. I respect the direction that Apple is going in. But for me personally, you know, I want to make things. And if there's no place for me to make things there, then I'll do what I did twice before
